content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms cater to a limited number of countries, impacting over 70% of the globe. Specifically, Stripe operates in just 46 countries out of 195 worldwide, leaving many creators in Nigeria and other regions unable to access their services. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH provide an alternative that guarantees creators ownership of their online stores and payment processes. With tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can deploy a fully functional store without the restrictions imposed by conventional payment platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal actively restrict access to their services based on geographical location, often citing regulatory compliance as the reason. This leads to creators being locked out and unable to monetize their digital products. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure does not discriminate by geography. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is designed specifically for creators in regions where conventional platforms are unavailable, allowing them to process payments in cryptocurrencies without facing the barriers that traditional services impose.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms like PayPal can hold funds for extended periods, sometimes up to 180 days, during which creators are left in uncertainty without appeal options. In comparison, sovereign commerce systems provide immediate access to funds through crypto payment processing. With NOWPayments, creators face a minimal fee of 0.5%, significantly lower than the hidden costs often associated with traditional payment platforms. The infrastructure ensures that transactions are processed swiftly, with minimal fees, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings without unnecessary delays.
Stripe is available in only 46 countries, leaving many creators behind.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the complete ownership that creators have over their online stores. Unlike platforms like Gumroad or Paddle, which retain control over customer data and product delivery, COREMERCH solutions ensure that all elements are owned by the creator after deployment. This includes automated payment verification and instant product delivery through systems like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, giving creators peace of mind and control over their digital assets without relying on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you're looking for a rapid solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack can be deployed quickly and is ideal for testing the waters. For those needing more robust features, the Edge Commerce Stack provides comprehensive capabilities including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for improved email deliverability. Creators can make informed decisions based on their product volume and technical requirements, ensuring they select a solution that fully meets their needs without the constraints of traditional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
With COREMERCH, you retain complete ownership of your digital products.

Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by assessing your product catalog and determining the number of items you wish to sell. Next, select the appropriate commerce stack from COREMERCH based on your requirements. Deploy your chosen stack through Cloudflare Pages or similar hosting services. Configure your payment processing with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Finally, test your store to ensure that product delivery and payment processing are seamless before going live.
